content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Bitcoin payments for digital downloads represent a transformative approach to e-commerce for creators facing financial isolation. Unlike traditional platforms that charge high fees—Gumroad, for instance, takes 10% on every sale—NOWPayments offers an incredibly low fee of just 0.5%. This shift not only saves money but also grants creators sovereignty over their sales, ensuring they receive the full value of their work without middlemen. This architectural change is crucial for digital creators who need reliable and cheap payment solutions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for facilitating Bitcoin payments involves a stack of free and paid tools that work in harmony. By utilizing platforms like Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and NOWPayments for payment processing, creators can automate transactions seamlessly. This architecture ensures that products, whether ebooks or software, are delivered instantly upon payment confirmation. The entire process is fully managed by the creator, who retains ownership of their data and does not depend on any external platform once set up.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in countries where mainstream payment processors are either unavailable or overly restrictive. Creators selling ebooks, templates, courses, and digital products can leverage Bitcoin payments to bypass traditional barriers and retain more profit. This infrastructure empowers creators to focus on their craft instead of navigating complex payment systems, allowing them to build and scale their businesses independently.
Save up to 9.5% on transaction fees compared to conventional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of a Bitcoin payment system for digital downloads relies on several key components: a hosting service like GitHub Pages for product delivery, backend logic via Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. These components integrate to form a cohesive system that automates order processing and ensures secure payment verification. By utilizing this stack, creators can manage and deliver their digital products efficiently, providing a better experience for their customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with Bitcoin payments for your digital products, first, set up your hosting service using GitHub Pages. Next, configure your backend logic via Google Apps Script to automate order processing. Then, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, test the entire system to ensure that payments are processed smoothly and products are delivered immediately. By following these steps, you can create an efficient and cost-effective platform for selling digital downloads.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use Bitcoin payments through a custom digital commerce stack. This allows you to bypass restrictive platforms and retain more of your earnings. By integrating services like NOWPayments, you can accept payments in cryptocurrency just like traditional platforms but at a fraction of the cost, ensuring your income remains intact.
Retain full ownership of your digital products and customer data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in selling digital products without platform fees, consider exploring our Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to set up your own sovereign commerce infrastructure. This kit enables you to sell directly to your audience without the limitations of traditional platforms. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept Bitcoin payments for my digital products?

You can accept Bitcoin payments by integrating NOWPayments into your digital commerce stack. This service allows you to process transactions automatically, ensuring that payments are confirmed on-chain before product delivery.
What are the fees associated with Bitcoin payments?
NOWPayments charges only a 0.5% fee on transactions, which is significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10%. This fee structure allows you to retain more revenue from each sale.
Can I automate the delivery of my digital products?

Yes, you can automate product delivery using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. These tools allow you to set up systems that deliver products instantly upon payment confirmation, enhancing the customer experience.
Is there a limit to the number of products I can sell?
There is no inherent limit to the number of products you can sell. The infrastructure allows you to scale as needed, whether you are selling three products or hundreds.
Do I need any technical skills to set this up?

While some technical skills can be helpful, the provided blueprints and templates in the Complete Builder Kit are designed to guide you through the setup process step-by-step, making it accessible for anyone.
